regions.today: Dry with sunny spells this evening.
regions.tonight: Dry with clear spells tonight. It’ll turn cloudier overnight. Lowest temperatures of 10 to 13 degrees in light northerly or variable breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Rather cloudy to begin tomorrow, Thursday. Sunny spells will develop more widely as the day goes on. Highest temperatures of 21 to 23 degrees in a light, occasionally moderate, northerly breeze.
regions.solar_uv: Mostly high today; Moderate to high tomorrow.
